pk.context: 145 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: This ester pro-drug is hydrolyzed to fenofibric acid, the active moiety whose exposure the label reports.

clues.text: Well absorbed, and exposure is not significantly different fasting or nonfasting. About 99% binds serum protein, and most is excreted in urine as metabolites.
An ester pro-drug with molecular weight 360.83, insoluble in water.
Approved under an NDA, as 48 mg and 145 mg tablets, dosed once daily.
No boxed warning. Contraindicated in severe renal impairment, active liver disease and gallbladder disease; liver test abnormalities and raised CPK are common reactions.
Adjunct to diet in adults with primary hypercholesterolemia or mixed dyslipidemia, and for severe hypertriglyceridemia.
Activates PPAR alpha, raising lipolysis and clearance of triglyceride-rich particles by activating lipoprotein lipase and reducing apoprotein C-III production.
The generic name begins with F and has eleven letters.
